intro: Elegant wedding receptions are what we do best at the Ballroom at the Cicero Grand. Flexible space, on-site catering, and a guest-room block — all in one place.
highlights: Ballroom seats up to 200 for plated dinner, 220 theater
Cocktail-hour space adjacent to the main ballroom
Discounted guest-room block for your party
Bridal suite available the night of

testimonials.quote: Brandi is amazing. Covid put so much stress into an already stressful planning process — they made it work, and the day was perfect.
It was a pleasure working with Janelle in the planning of my son's wedding. The entire staff was helpful from start to finish.
Beautiful ballroom, attentive staff, and our guests loved that they could just walk upstairs at the end of the night.
